> **Not yet implemented.** In the current build this command prints
> `verify artifact: not implemented yet` and exits with code 2.

## Usage

```text
provenance verify artifact [flags]
```

Hash a binary's raw bytes — this binary if `--path` is not given, or any file, such as an independently rebuilt candidate — and check it against the published release manifest. The file being checked is only read, never executed.

Exit codes: 0 hash matches, 1 mismatch, 2 tool or usage error.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--path file` | — | file to check instead of the running binary |
